note: EfficientNet-B0 fine-tuned in-house on hand-labelled SWISS-CI plates. The checkpoint arrived with no held-out accuracy; ee34729 measured one on 4 unseen plates (276 images): accuracy 84.1%, crystal recall 73%, precision 70%, within-plate AUC 0.89-0.95. The reported val figure of 96.4% was chosen on, and is not evidence.
